description: We are are determinated and strong team made with 5 close friends.Even if lose even if we suffer we wont stop.TO THE SPACE AND BEYOND!
summary: We want to encourage young people and new generations to take an interest in space. To this end, we have crafted a narrative and integrated it into a slide presentation. The story follows a young girl and a rabbit as they travel back in time to learn about historical spacecraft; through what they discover, they come to the realization that today’s youth have the potential to achieve great success in the field of spacecraft in the future.
details: We have created a story designed to spark children's interest in space and inspire them to learn more about it. The project consists of a 7-slide presentation, with the story unfolding across these slides. The characters in the story are a young girl and a rabbit.
